intro: Professionals and everyday users convert miles per hour (mph) to meters per second (m/s) when working across imperial and si standards in automotive speedometer readings, aviation airspeed navigation, maritime chart plotting, and meteorology. One miles per hour equals 0.44704 meters per second, while 1 meters per second equals 2.236936 miles per hour. Whether you are verifying speed specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact NIST Factor vs. Early Rounding Drift
items: The exact conversion factor from Miles per Hour to Meters per Second is 0.44704, derived from the 1959 International Yard and Pound Agreement (1 inch = 25.4 mm, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg).

In structural engineering, CNC machining, or bulk inventory totals, rounding the multiplier to 2 decimal places too early can introduce cumulative tolerance errors; always compute with the full factor and round only the final displayed figure.

faqs.question: How many meters per second (m/s) are in 1 miles per hour (mph)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.44704 meters per second (m/s) in 1 miles per hour (mph), which rounds to 0.447 m/s for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 meters per second equals 2.236936 miles per hour.

faqs.question: How do I convert miles per hour to meters per second (mph to m/s)?
faqs.answer: To convert miles per hour to meters per second, use the formula: m/s = mph × 0.44704. For example, converting 50 mph gives 22.352 m/s.

faqs.question: What is 50 miles per hour in meters per second?
faqs.answer: 50 miles per hour (mph) equals exactly 22.352 meters per second (m/s) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
